title: Passage 4
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: At an early age, we start learning how to manage money by watching our parents' spending habits.
sentences.cn: 我们就开始通过观察父母的消费习惯来学习如何管理金钱。

sentences.en: We need to know that our parents work hard to make money and that it may be used up one day.
sentences.cn: 我们需要明白，父母努力工作赚钱，而这些钱可能总有一天会用完。

sentences.en: Going to their workplaces to watch how they work is a great way to understand money is not that easy to make.
sentences.cn: 去他们工作的地方看看他们是如何工作的，是理解赚钱不易的好方法。

sentences.en: We should not spend all our money in one go.
sentences.cn: 我们不应该一下花光所有的钱。

sentences.en: It's important for us to have a budget.
sentences.cn: 对我们来说，制定一个预算是很重要的。

sentences.en: We need to think about how much money we have for the monthly bills and what we really want to spend money on,
sentences.cn: 我们需要考虑我们有多少钱来支付每月的账单，以及我们真正想把钱花在什么东西上，要意识到零花钱不能买下我们想要的一切。

sentences.en: realising that our pocket money can't cover everything we want.
sentences.cn: 我们需要考虑我们有多少钱来支付每月的账单，以及我们真正想把钱花在什么东西上，要意识到零花钱不能买下我们想要的一切。

sentences.en: We should make smart spending choices.
sentences.cn: 我们应该做出明智的消费选择。

sentences.en: We should set a clear goal and watch our money grow.
sentences.cn: 我们应该设定一个明确的目标，并看着我们的钱慢慢增多。

sentences.en: If we wish to own a new bicycle but can't afford it, we can save our pocket money.
Write down how much money we have in a notebook and watch it grow.
sentences.cn: 在笔记本上写下我们有多少钱，并看着它增多。

sentences.en: After we have enough, we can buy that wonderful bicycle we've dreamed about.
sentences.cn: 我们就可以买下那辆梦寐以求的漂亮自行车了！

sentences.en: Reaching our goal will greatly satiate us.
sentences.cn: 实现目标会让我们感到非常满足。

sentences.en: We can talk with our parents about how money is used and where money goes.
sentences.cn: 我们可以和父母谈谈钱是怎么用的，以及钱都花在哪里了。

sentences.en: We can also go to the supermarket with our parents to experience how money is spent in the real world.
sentences.cn: 我们还可以和父母一起去超市，体验在现实生活中钱是如何被花出去的。

sentences.en: Without doubt, we should treat money in a right way.
sentences.cn: 我们应该以正确的方式对待金钱。

sentences.en: Actually, learning about money isn't a hard job.
sentences.cn: 学习金钱知识并不是一件难事。

sentences.en: From these lessons, we can get a sense of money management and right money values step by step.
sentences.cn: 我们可以逐步树立理财的意识和正确的金钱观！
